summary: Voters in Chandpur mostly talk about flood-hit and waterlogged villages, poor village drainage, district health and power gaps, and unpaid cane dues, with the town's rail links and station the main thing they appreciate.

round2.changes: Opened and checked all 9 cited URLs (7 supported, 2 supported with caveats: Chandpur Wikipedia transport section uncited; Basera directory undated). Removed Chelapur: its Wikipedia page places it in Noorpur vidhan sabha, not Chandpur. Replaced 2019 Quint sugar item as lead sugar negative with Amar Ujala 2 Oct 2026 (Bilai mill dues, district). Replaced flood-water-receded positive (not a delivered benefit) with Kakrala Bhagwantpur drain clearing (Bhaskar 8 Sep 2026, municipal action). Reordered and re-ranked. Kept Mussoorie/Garhwal station item (Chandpur town, inside AC per AC extent). Added weak rail-links item from Chandpur Wikipedia. Market item stays a flagged inference. Checked AC extent (Wikipedia): KCs Chandpur, Basta, Phoona; Chandpur MB; Chandpur tehsil.

positives.english: Mussoorie and Garhwal Express stop at Chandpur station
positives.hindi: चांदपुर स्टेशन पर मसूरी और गढ़वाल एक्सप्रेस रुकती हैं
positives.basis: Wikipedia (undated; no date given for train service): Chandpur Siau station, Chandpur, Bijnor; Mussoorie Express, Garhwal Express and Lucknow-Chandigarh Express stop there. Station is in Chandpur town (Chandpur MB), which the AC extent lists, so inside the AC.

positives.english: The municipality got the drains cleared, and children can now go to school more easily
positives.hindi: पालिका ने नाले साफ कराए, बच्चे अब आसानी से स्कूल जाते हैं
positives.basis: Bhaskar (8 Sep 2026): after an SDM Chandpur order (21 Aug 2026), Chandpur Municipal Council's EO sent a team; drains and nalas cleared, water drained from the main road at Kakrala Bhagwantpur, where 2-3 ft of water had stood. Students can travel to school more easily, per three school principals' complaints. AC membership of the village is not confirmed (Chandpur tehsil; the SDM and municipal action are local).

positives.english: Trains to Delhi, Lucknow and Roorkee are available from Chandpur
positives.hindi: चांदपुर से दिल्ली, लखनऊ और रुड़की की ट्रेन मिल जाती है
positives.basis: Wikipedia (Chandpur, Bijnor; undated): railway connections to New Delhi, Lucknow, Saharanpur, Roorkee, Chandigarh, and direct bus services to New Delhi. Transport section is tagged as citing no sources (Sep 2022), so treat as weak. Town is inside the AC.

positives.english: *Shops for daily needs and a market are close by in Chandpur town
positives.hindi: *चांदपुर में रोज़मर्रा की दुकानें और बाज़ार पास में मिल जाते हैं
positives.basis: Inference: no source found on Chandpur market facilities. Based only on the town being a municipal board (nagar palika parishad) with a population of 83,441 (2011 census, Wikipedia). Needs field check.

positives.english: 137 health sub-centres in the district have quality certificates
positives.hindi: जिले के 137 उपकेंद्रों को गुणवत्ता प्रमाण पत्र मिला है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (16 Jul 2026): Bijnor ranks 4th in the state and 1st in its division for NQAS certificates; 137 health sub-centres in the district received the certificate, per CMO Dr. Kaushalendra Singh. District-level, not AC-specific. This is an official certificate, not a service voters can see, so it ranks last.

negatives.english: Nine villages are still surrounded by flood water, tractors are the only way out
negatives.hindi: बाढ़ से नौ गांव अब भी घिरे हैं, ट्रैक्टर ही सहारा है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (3 Aug 2026), dateline Jalilpur: water in the Ganga khadar fell, but nine villages remain surrounded by water; movement is difficult, tractors are the main way to travel, and access roads Siyali-Dattiyana, Siyali-Sujatpur Khadar, Muzaffarpur Khadar-Dattiyana and Sujatpur Khadar-Dattiyana were damaged. Named villages (Dattiyana, Siyali, Kumariya, Raipur Khadar, etc.) are not confirmed inside the AC extent. District-level.

negatives.english: Power cuts and no diesel in the generator stop dialysis at the district hospital
negatives.hindi: बिजली कटती है, जनरेटर में डीजल नहीं, डायलिसिस रुक जाता है
negatives.basis: Quint Hindi (22 Jun 2025): at Bijnor district hospital a 26-year-old patient's dialysis stopped due to power cuts and no diesel in the generator for about a month, per his mother; DM Jasjeet Kaur acknowledged that diesel was needed during power cuts. Part of a wider UP power-cut story. District-level (Bijnor city hospital), not inside the AC.

negatives.english: Bilai sugar mill still owes cane money, farmers are upset
negatives.hindi: बिलाई मिल पर गन्ने का बकाया है, किसान परेशान हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (2 Oct 2026), Bijnor dateline: unpaid cane payment from the Bilai sugar mill is causing financial trouble for farmers; about 5,000 affidavits to be taken from farmers if dues stay unpaid. No amount stated. Mill's block and whether it is in the AC are not stated, so this is district-level.

negatives.english: There is no drain in the village, and drain water goes straight into water bodies
negatives.hindi: गांव में नाली नहीं, नाली का पानी सीधे जल स्रोतों में जाता है
negatives.basis: onefivenine village directory (census-linked, undated; years mentioned are 2011 and 2021 copyright): Basera is in Chandpur tehsil, Jalilpur C.D. block, Bijnor; 'No Drainage System Available in this Village'; 'Drain water is discharged directly into water bodies'. AC membership unconfirmed: Basera is not in the AC extent's listed Kanungo circles or patwar circles. Directory entry, not news; needs field check.

negatives.english: Sugar mills have cane money pending and farmers are still waiting
negatives.hindi: चीनी मिलों पर गन्ने का बकाया है, किसानों का पैसा अटका है
negatives.basis: The Quint (27 Sep 2019, old): farmers in Bijnor district say around nine sugar mills owe some Rs 500 crore, unpaid since 2018; the district cane officer was quoted saying FIRs would be registered. Mills not named; district-level and dated 2019. Kept only as background; no 2024-26 Chandpur mill source was found.

notes: Chandpur AC local coverage is still thin. About 45 Hindi and English searches across Amar Ujala, Bhaskar, Dainik Jagran, Patrika, Quint, Public App, Royal Bulletin and tender pages. Found Chandpur-town items: the municipal drain-clearing at Kakrala Bhagwantpur (Bhaskar, Aug-Sep 2026, Chandpur SDM and municipal EO) and a Sep 2026 Amar Ujala jewellery theft (not used: one incident). No 2024-26 AC-specific negative could be tied to a place confirmed inside the AC, so ac_specific_negatives is 0. Kakrala Bhagwantpur, Siyali, Dattiyana, Sujatpur Khadar and Basera could not be placed in the AC extent (Kanungo circles Chandpur, Basta, Phoona; patwar circles listed on the AC Wikipedia page). Chelapur was removed: its Wikipedia page places it in the Noorpur vidhan sabha. Excluded: Patrika 27 Aug 2018 flood article (old, outside AC); Aaj Tak 10 Sep 2025 Ganga embankment erosion (no AC village named); Chandpur tenders on aggregator sites (not citable). Negative 5 is from 2019 and needs a current-status check; the Bilai 2026 item is district-level with no amount. AC incumbent per Wikipedia: Swami Omvesh (Samajwadi Party, elected 2022), not used as political content. Suggested field check: Kakrala Bhagwantpur and Chandpur municipal drains, Chandpur Siau station, Chandpur CHC power and generator, Ganga khadar villages (Siyali, Dattiyana, Sujatpur Khadar) and the Chandpur AC boundary, and the Bilai mill's cane dues for 2026. Round 3 voice pass: spoken-voice rewording of P2, P4, N4; no facts added. P5 weak positive: the NQAS certificate is an official rating, not a service voters can see; district-level. N5 uses a 2019 source, so its present-tense wording is not verified for 2026.
